intro: Yvette Farthing is a Forsaken resident of Brill in Tirisfal Glades, dwelling in the Gallows' End Tavern alongside her father, Coleman. Though she appears as hardened and detached as any of Sylvanas's people, she carries the lingering ghost of a mortal romance cut short by the Scourge.

p: Before the Third War swept Lordaeron into ruin, Yvette was in love with Thurman Agamand, one of the heirs of the prosperous Agamand Mills. When the Scourge plague approached, Yvette and her father, Coleman, begged Thurman to abandon the estate and flee with them. Thurman refused out of devotion to his family's legacy. Both would eventually perish and rise into undeath, but while Yvette found a place among the free-willed Forsaken in Brill, Thurman's tragic final fate remained unknown to her.
